title: Sort products by price

story.iWant: to sort the product list by price
story.soThat: I find the cheapest or the dearest item first

why: Shoppers on a budget look for the cheapest item first.
alreadyThere: The product list has a sort control with Price (low to high) and Price (high to low).

criteria.when: the shopper picks Price (low to high)
criteria.then: Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99 is first

criteria.when: the shopper picks Price (high to low)
criteria.then: Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket at $49.99 is first

criteria.when: the shopper adds an item to the cart
criteria.then: the order of the list does not change

covered.test: Price (low to high) shows the cheapest product first
